observations.body: The devil shows Jesus the kingdoms and their glory, offers them for worship, and hears Jesus command Satan to leave while quoting worship owed to God alone.
observations.label: Kingdoms are offered in exchange for worship

observations.body: The passage presents Showing, offering, worshiping, and serving as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Showing, offering, worshiping, and serving

observations.body: The passage places Worship and service belong to God beside Showing, offering, worshiping, and serving.
observations.label: Worship and service belong to God

payload.posture: Read Matthew 4:8–10 as one movement in the temptation of Jesus, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the devil shows Jesus the kingdoms and their glory, offers them for worship, and hears Jesus command Satan to leave while quoting worship owed to God alone. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the temptation of Jesus.
payload.title: Kingdoms are offered in exchange for worship
